trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is nothing separate to hunt. Plan the run around the two golds (the final mission and 100% completion) and treat this as the last trophy that pops, after roughly 200 hours of play according to the published roadmaps.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1. It cannot be missed: play the introduction, follow Jason through the mission beats, and the trophy pops at the mission complete screen.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and the trophy unlocks as the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1 behind, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude): it is the one trophy-related moment the chapter does not give back.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete all of Chapter 2's main missions. The chapter also unlocks playing properly as both protagonists: after the Coffee Break mission you can meditate with Jason and Lucia together, which the final meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude requires.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 3's main missions to the chapter end card. Nothing in the chapter is missable for trophies, and free roam continues afterwards, so side content can safely wait if you want to push the story.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's main missions. This chapter matters beyond the story: an optional mission here opens up the bank vault jobs that Maximum Withdrawal and the 100% checklist depend on, so take optional markers as they appear.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)
PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold for finishing the final story mission at the end of Chapter 5. There is no mission replay and no difficulty setting to worry about; once the credits roll you keep free-roaming, and the 100% Completion checklist unlocks for the A Long Road grind.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Like every named-mission trophy on this list it is awarded automatically at the mission's end and cannot be missed, because the story must pass through it.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a set-piece story mission. It pops on completion regardless of how clean the getaway is, so just survive the job; your performance is not graded for the trophy.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. An automatic story unlock: reach the mission through normal progression and finish it, no optional objectives required.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It unlocks as part of the main path and is awarded when the mission ends, however you handled its encounters.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown at the airport. Finishing the mission is the whole requirement; the separate Catch Me If You Can trophy also involves VCIA, but that one is a free-roam stunt, not this mission.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Awarded automatically at mission end as part of the main campaign; nothing optional feeds into it.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long gold: reach 100% on the completion checklist that unlocks after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). The checklist is more forgiving than it looks — the published roadmaps note it asks for a share of the game's content rather than literally everything, including every robbery, bank vault and gang operation, the shooting ranges and drone races, and 70 of the 80 challenges. Guides rate it the hardest trophy on the list and the bulk of the roughly 200-hour platinum; work it steadily in free roam after the credits.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts across Leonida: stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all feed the same counter, and trackers count far more stunt opportunities in the world (around 397) than the 250 you need. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy if you are chasing A Long Road. Track the running total in the Progress menu.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity types once each: the published list is fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You only have to try each one, not win or finish it, so knock this out early in free roam by visiting one marker of every type.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold-medal all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work range by range and weapon class by weapon class, learning each target pattern; a challenge only counts at gold, so replay the ones that fall short until the medal colour changes. The ranges also appear on the 100% checklist, so none of the practice is wasted.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. A win at each course is what counts, not a finishing position streak, so retry a course until you take first place, then move on; the courses stay available in free roam, including after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not add to the counter, so tour the race markers around Leonida and take a first place at each new one. Any vehicle class counts as long as it is a distinct race event.
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in his fishing challenge. Find Cal at his fishing spot, accept the challenge, and land the better catch before the timer ends; if he wins, the challenge can be retried, so treat the first attempt as practice for his target weight.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade cabinet in Leonida. Pick the shortest game on offer, play it to its end screen rather than quitting out, and the trophy pops; it also ticks the video game slot for Master of None.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: See Andy's questline through to its last mission (his finale is the mission Puff Puff Pass, per the published lists). Andy's strand is played as Lucia; work his markers whenever they appear, and do not worry if he goes quiet mid-story — quest givers tied to trophies become available again, and his strand can be finished after the credits.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's questline through its final mission. Kenton can be temporarily unavailable at points in the story, which the guides flag as normal rather than a lockout: his markers return, and the strand can be closed out in free roam after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline by completing his final mission. Follow his strand of markers to the end; like the other character questlines it stays completable in free roam, so a missed mid-story window does not cost the trophy.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. A strand means the whole chain for one stranger, first meeting to finale, not eight single encounters. The character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) are the backbone; stranger strands are not part of the 100% checklist, but the trophy needs eight of them done, and they remain available after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's questline through its final mission. Keep returning to his markers as the strand unfolds; it counts toward the eight strands for Strangers & Freaks as well, and it can be finished after the story if you leave it late.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline with his final mission. Tyrone's strand is played as Jason, per the published guides; work his markers when they appear and close the strand out in free roam if the story pulls you away.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: MISSABLE — the only trophy on the list you can lock yourself out of. Meditate at all 18 meditation spots, spread over 10 locations. The trap is the first one: during Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia is in the kitchen at Jason's house talking about meditating, then walks out to the balcony — follow her, choose Accept, and complete the meditation with her. That spot disappears for good when Chapter 1 ends, and guides have not confirmed whether the trophy's counter can reach 18 without it, so never skip it. The remaining spots are ordinary map meditation points; meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice, and the final spot needs both characters together, which only becomes possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track the counter under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and keep a manual save before finishing Chapter 1.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret's hunting request by tracking and killing the unique animal he sends you after. Bret's strand is played as Jason; study animals as you travel so your hunting knowledge is ready, then follow his hunt to its end — the target is a one-of-a-kind animal, not a species count.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the world, so you only need a sixth of the total card pool: pick the three sets you are closest to finishing and hunt their remaining cards rather than spreading effort across all 18. Bret's Target Deck quests feed into the card hunt, so pair the two grinds.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app to scan 100 locations around Leonida. Landmarks, curiosities and sculptures all count, so scan opportunistically whenever you pass something notable instead of leaving it for one long sweep; the counter is tracked in the Progress menu and the 100% checklist overlaps with it.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges. This one usually arrives on the road to A Long Road, whose checklist asks for 70 of 80, so you will pass 50 naturally if you work the checklist; if you want it early, clear the short activity challenges (races, ranges, stunts) first.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While travelling with your partner (the other protagonist), raise a four-star wanted level, then break line of sight and let the heat die down completely without being busted or wasted. A fast car and a route into tunnels, alleys or off-road ground makes the escape much easier; the trophy pops once the stars clear with your partner still with you.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, rob three shops in one continuous wanted run: the wanted level must stay alive between robberies, so pick three shops close together, move fast, and do not hide long enough for the stars to drop. Empty each register, get straight back in the car, and hit the next shop while the heat is still on.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles by getting in and driving them (scanning vehicles as you go is the habit the roadmaps recommend building during the story). Every new model you drive adds one to the count; steal broadly in traffic, parking lots and marinas instead of reusing your favourite car, and the counter fills long before the story ends.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop five enemies during one Combat Focus activation. Set it up before you trigger the ability: pick a crowded fight (a gang operation or a robbery gone loud), line up at least five targets in the open, then enter Combat Focus and work through them without letting the effect lapse. Headshots keep the streak fast enough to fit all five in one use.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, the airport, steal an aircraft and take off without clearance — an unscheduled departure. Get airside, take a plane, and get airborne; expect a wanted level, so climb away and lose the heat afterwards. This is free-roam mischief at the airport, separate from the VCIA Takedown story mission.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This is the Rhino tank trophy: it is tied to an encounter with the military's Rhino armour, the kind of heat that only shows up once you push a wanted level to its ceiling. Guides are still pinning down the exact trigger, so the working approach is to provoke a maximum response, get to the Rhino that answers, and interact with it — commandeering or surviving the encounter is what the description jokes about. Make a manual save first so an experiment costs you nothing.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get out without ever being detected: no alarm, no witness completing a call, no wanted stars earned inside. Go in quiet, control the room without firing a shot, take the goods and leave on foot to a discreet car. If anyone spots you mid-robbery, walk away and try another store rather than forcing it.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape cleanly after each one. There are eight vaults in Leonida and the bank jobs open up through an optional mission in Chapter 4, so the trophy only becomes available mid-story; the 100% checklist wants all eight, making this a waypoint rather than the end of the grind. An escape means losing the wanted level with the money, not just leaving the bank.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Take down an armored cash truck in free roam, grab the money from the back, and escape the response. Stop or disable the truck, force the rear doors (explosives or sustained fire do it), collect the cash, then break line of sight and let the wanted level die. One successful truck-and-escape is the whole trophy.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Reveal the whole state: Leonida is divided into 52 areas, and each one counts as explored once you travel into it and clear its fog from the map. Most areas open up naturally across the story and checklist grind; at the end, compare your map against the area counter and sweep the untouched corners — island chains and swamp pockets are the usual stragglers.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of Leonida's nine gangs. Variety is the requirement, not volume: nine robberies total, each against a different gang's operation, so track which gangs you have already hit and travel for the missing ones. These robberies also sit on the 100% checklist, so the two goals progress together.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail at a beachfront spot, and enjoy it looking out at the view. It is a quiet scene trophy rather than a challenge: be at Ocean Beach, drink in hand, scenery in front of you, and let the moment play out. Launch-era guides list its exact trigger as still being pinned down, so if it does not pop at the first bar, try the beachfront cocktail spots along the strip at a relaxed hour.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Get inside a vehicle showroom, take one of the display cars, and drive it straight out through the showroom glass. The trophy wants the theatrical exit — through the window in a showroom car, in classic style — not the door, and not a car you brought with you. Launch-era guides still list the fine trigger details as unconfirmed, so any showroom with a car on the floor and glass facing the street is the place to try it.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Head to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through there: play the alley's bowling through to the end of the game rather than quitting mid-frames. Published lists describe the alley objective around its key valuables, so while you are there, finish everything the alley asks of you in one visit and let the trophy register at the end.
sources: Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The partnership trophy is about building both protagonists up: published lists report it as maxing out the strength stat with both Jason and Lucia. Work each character's strength up through fighting, sports and physical activities until both sit at their peak; swap protagonists regularly so neither lags behind, and check both profiles in the Progress stats.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This one fills up on its own: PlayStation tracks a count that runs to 500 choices, and every decision the game logs — dialogue picks, mission approaches, free-roam calls — adds to it. Play normally, take the choices the story and side content offer rather than skipping them, and the trophy lands deep into a full playthrough without any dedicated grind.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description gives the shape of it: fail at something, then succeed at it on the second try. Launch-era guides list the precise trigger as still unconfirmed, so the practical advice is not to reload the instant something goes wrong — let a failed attempt stand, retry it straight away, and let the second-chance success register. It tends to arrive unplanned during challenges and missions with a retry.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A witness trophy: be present for one of Leonida's strange, unexplained events and watch it happen. Published guides still list the exact event as unconfirmed at launch, so treat it as an explorer's trophy — linger in odd places, follow up strange sights and sounds in the wilds rather than fast-travelling past them, and when something impossible happens, stay and watch it to the end.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee strike delivered from a moving vehicle — a drive-by melee, not a shot and not simply running them over. Ride or drive past a pedestrian at moderate speed and swing as you pass; the hit has to come from the melee attack while you are rolling. A motorcycle at street speed through a busy pavement area is the easiest setup.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; instead of spending them raw, pass them through the laundering contacts the game gives you and let the cleaned total build up. It is a cumulative counter, so every laundered batch counts — prioritise robbery income through the laundering route until the quarter million is reached.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (https://www.keengamer.com/articles/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-platinum-roadmap-all-55-trophies/)

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 in shops across Leonida — clothes, weapons, vehicle work, supplies, all of it counts together. It fills naturally across a 200-hour run; if it is somehow still short at the end, a deliberate shopping spree on high-end gear closes the gap in minutes.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
Radio Times — GTA 6 trophy guide: full list of trophies and achievements (https://www.radiotimes.com/technology/gaming/gta-6-trophies-achievements-list/)

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all eight garage properties on the map. Garages come up for sale as you explore and earn; sweep the property markers, keep enough cash aside for the later, pricier ones, and the eighth purchase pops the trophy. The garages double as vehicle storage for the 100-vehicle discovery grind, so buy them as they appear rather than at the end.
sources: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide and Roadmap (https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap)
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you want to keep, register it through the app instead of abandoning it; ten registrations is all the trophy asks, so do it with the first ten keepers you find and it is done inside the opening hours.
sources: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List (https://www.gtabase.com/articles/gta-6/gta-6-achievements-trophies-list-ps5-xbox-series)
